competitors.read: The two German rivals advertise on both Google (40 and 18 ads) and Meta (12 and 25), so both channels pay for someone selling this product here. The UK rival ranks but runs no German ads. 3 of the top 10 are software directories.

budget.why_not_spend_more: At the home paid click share of 4.76%, German search offers about 429 paid clicks a month; spending the whole ceiling would mean buying clicks German search doesn't have. The reach cap for 90 days is $1,816.12.

stop_rules.line: CPC above $1.83 (1.3 x planned): fix the terms. Sign-up rate below 2.78% (0.5 x planned), read once it has 150 clicks: fix the German landing page. Recheck at day 45 (2027-02-24); stop if still out.
Cost per sign-up at or under $88.50 ($491.68 ceiling x 0.18): promote to test with a read budget for the days left. Above it: stop.
Cost per sign-up at or under $31.73 (1.25 x planned): release the $355.34 reserve. Above $50.76 (2 x planned): stop the channel.

day_90_verdict.go: 5 or more paying customers from the test and blended cost per customer at or under $491.68.
day_90_verdict.extend_45_days: Sign-ups at 14 or more (50% of the 28 planned) but fewer than 5 customers, or cost per customer up to $737.52 (1.5 x the ceiling).
day_90_verdict.lag_note: Sign-ups pay after a median of 14 days, under 30, so the verdict is read on day 90 itself.
day_90_verdict.plan_expects: 28 Google Search sign-ups x 0.18 = 5.04 customers, plus any from the partner pilot, directories and a promoted Meta channel.
